notes: I worked these out by hand and have not run the plan checker. The done-check is that bun tools/plan/cli.ts exits 0. Spacing along each line: T1 is 308 m then 310 m. T2 is about 320, 330, 331.5 and 321 m. S1 is 255 m then 245 m. Every 30 m tram platform and 50 m sky platform is on straight track or beam, clear of the fillets.

Fix for the critic: I have taken out S1/skyport. At (545,0) it sits over water, and water blocks a walk, so nobody could reach it. No walkable place fits either. The quay pier ends at x 385, and S-S2 needs the station at x 540 or more (at least 200 m past Harbour at 340). S1's listed stations now end at Harbour, while the beam runs on to the turning loop.

For Datum (via Aster): Skyport is the stop the airport line exists for, and it cannot be placed until the plan has walkable public space by the loop, between x 540 and 708. That means a skyport apron, quay or foot path joined to Crown Parade or Harbour Road. Once it exists I will place the station there with fronts set to that path's id. I have not moved any plan geometry.

S1/harbour at (340,0) sits on the quay pier (x 330 to 385, y -25 to 25). Its platform runs from x 315 to 365, and its entrance opens onto the quay walk beside Harbour Road (x 288 to 312). It is 33.5 m from the T2/harbour stop.

N-R1 reach, by hand: the worst plots are crescent-north, 247 m from S1/circus, and crown-terraces, 247 m from S1/gardens. Both pass, but with little margin. rocket-west and lantern-west are in reach only through T2/sunset. Dropping Skyport changes no reach, because there are no plots east of the quay.

Interchange pairs: T1/circus to S1/circus is 119 m, T1/records to T2/market 55 m, and T2/harbour to S1/harbour 33.5 m. All are within the 150 m limit, so the three lines form one connected network (N-C1).

All of T2 depends on Sky accepting the line, which is still an open question in the plan. If T2 is dropped, rocket-west fails N-R1 (273 m from T1/records) and T1/records loses its interchange. The stops would then need placing again.

For Waymark: T2/sunset and T2/market are on Market Street, outside the Records Precinct's two vehicle gates, so police can seal them. For Pulse: the busiest transfer crowd will be at Boulevard × Market Street, 40 m west of T2/market.
